transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hello, Dr. Smith. Well, what brings me in is that... I've just been living with this constant mix of guilt, fear, and anger ever since my friend was killed. It just hasn't eased up the way everyone seemed to think it would by now, so I figured I needed to come in.
Do you find that you are frequently having unwanted, distressing memories or nightmares about the event?

Yes, I do. It doesn't even take much to set it off. Just... hearing a crosswalk signal, or the growl of a truck going by, or even seeing a walking-tour map. Any of those things can suddenly put the whole scene right back in my head. It comes back so sharply that I can see my friend stepping off the curb before I can even stop the thought from happening.
How long ago did this traumatic event occur?
It happened about two years and three months ago. We were on that walking tour when she was killed, and... well, this has all been going on ever since then.
